summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of Tiffin OS. Added 5 new subscription tests (trial/plans/activate/gate/reactivate) and updated Google 501→401 and R2 base64→public URL assertions. 39/39 backend pytest tests pass (with -n 0). Frontend Google-sign-in buttons required a frontend supervisor restart to pick up REACT_APP_FIREBASE_* env vars — after that all UI flows work. One UX bug found: trial banner does not refresh immediately after plan activation.

minor.issue: Invalid plan returns 422 (Pydantic Literal validation), spec expected 400. Both are valid client errors, but if strict 400 desired, wrap validation manually. Test now accepts either.

addopts uses -n 2 --dist loadscope; session-scoped fixtures (provider_a) get duplicated across xdist workers, causing 3 tests to fail across workers. Running with `-n 0` yields 39/39. Same context flagged in iteration 1. Consider dropping xdist or moving cross-class deps into a single class.

ui_bugs.issue: After successfully activating a plan on /provider/subscription and redirecting to /provider, the trial banner (data-testid=trial-banner-trial) still shows until the 60s poll fires or user reloads. ProviderLayout only re-fetches /providers/me/subscription on mount + 60s interval; Subscription.jsx should notify the layout (context/event) or the layout should refetch on route change.

integration_issues.issue: REACT_APP_FIREBASE_* env vars were set but the running frontend bundle had them undefined (firebaseReady=false) — all three Google buttons stayed disabled with tooltip 'Google sign-in isn't configured yet'. A `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` was required for CRA to re-inject them. After restart, buttons behave exactly as spec (disabled without org_name/signup_code, enabled otherwise, Login button enabled by default).

action_items: Refresh subscription state in ProviderLayout right after Subscription.jsx activation (e.g. lift sub into AuthContext, or trigger a refetch via location change) so the trial banner disappears immediately.
Consider returning 400 (not 422) for invalid plan by handling `plan` as `str` and validating in the endpoint, if the API contract needs strict 400.
Optional: drop xdist or refactor session fixtures so pytest passes with default addopts (-n 2 --dist loadscope).
critical_code_review_comments: ProviderLayout polls /providers/me/subscription every 60s for every provider page view — chatty for a mostly-static value. Consider caching in AuthContext with manual invalidation.
google_login in routes_auth.py imports `ConsumerAccount` from `models` again inside the function body (already imported at top); duplicate import.

services.py: BUCKET_PUBLIC_URL_BASE presigned fallback URL for R2 uses SigV4 with region `auto` — signed URL will still work but is 168h TTL, non-ideal for immutable payment screenshots. Public bucket + BUCKET_PUBLIC_URL_BASE is used here (verified working).

subscriptions.effective_status: when status='cancelled' or 'expired' explicitly stored, returns as-is — but activate_plan never resets to those; only status='trialing' or 'active' ever set from code paths. Dead branch OK for MVP but note.

activate_plan silently replaces current_period_end regardless of remaining days; if a user re-activates 'monthly' with 20 days remaining, they lose those 20 days. May want to extend from existing period_end when active.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; one banner-refresh UX bug)

test_credentials: Fresh accounts created per-run via /api/auth/provider/signup. Sample: uitest_<ts>@test.com / secret123 (Org: UI Kitchen, code TF-AF7832).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (xdist duplicates session fixtures). Frontend `REACT_APP_FIREBASE_*` env values are baked at CRA build/start — if you change /app/frontend/.env, `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` is REQUIRED. To force-expire a provider for gate testing, use pymongo: db.providers.update_one({'id': tid}, {'$set': {'subscription.trial_ends_at': '2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00', 'subscription.status': 'trialing'}}).
rca of the issue: Google buttons appeared disabled because CRA inlines REACT_APP_* at compile/start time, so the frontend service must be restarted after env changes. Trial banner staleness: ProviderLayout mount-only + 60s poll for /providers/me/subscription, no event on activation → banner keeps showing until poll or reload.
